pages.text: Akaishi ore clusters come in four densities:$(li)$(bold)Low$(): most common, drops 1 Crystal$(li)$(bold)Medium$(): drops 2$(li)$(bold)Perfect$(): drops 3$(li)$(bold)Flawless$(): rarest, drops 4$(br2)No matter the density, the drop count is $(bold)fixed$() — $(bold)Fortune$() and $(bold)Luck$() do not increase it!
A flawless cluster — a rare, perfect crystal formation.
